overview.description: The Nicholas Gold Income ETF (GLDN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in target outcome asset allocation. The fund actively manages a portfolio composed of gold companies, gold commodities, and options overlay. The funds selection process is based on valuation, implied volatility, company fundamentals, and macroeconomic factors, including real interest rates and inflation GLDN was launched on Feb 18, 2026 and is issued by Nicholas.
